title: Two defects on a machined part
intro: A = a part has a surface defect, P(A) = 0.12. B = a part is out of dimensional tolerance, P(B) = 0.08. Both happen on 3 % of parts, P(A ∩ B) = 0.03. Read P(A ∪ B) = 0.17 by the addition rule, the two conditional probabilities P(A | B) = 0.375 and P(B | A) = 0.25, and the independence check: 0.03 is not 0.12 × 0.08 = 0.0096, so the defects are not independent.
